title: Build claim links for FlowWeb's lead hunts: signed, off by default, suppression-checked, a posted event per organizer, and Frequency never sends the message

source.ref: FlowWeb row FW-C-041 (saved event lead hunts). Daniel, 2026-11-10: 'set up auto hunts for events, find their creators email or contact info ... send them a customized lead message with a claim link. The building stuff / claim link can be a second selectible layer.' Then, 2026-11-10: Resend's rules ban cold outreach, so hunt messages go from Daniel's own Workspace mailbox ('follow the rules'), and 'Build the thing' (the claim-link builder).

detail:
POST /api/webhooks/flowweb-claim takes one FlowWeb hunt item with build on, signed as hex HMAC-SHA256 of `${x-flowweb-timestamp}.${body}` under FLOWWEB_CLAIM_SECRET (5 minute window; no secret = 401). The item must name a deliverable address, the public page it came from (which the body must quote), FlowWeb's 'reply no' opt-out and the {{claim_url}} slot. Gates in order: FLOWWEB_CLAIM_ENABLED (envFlag, off by default, answers off), suppression (global or the root Space's own opt-outs, fail-closed, answers suppressed). Then the event is posted for its organizer through the existing poster-events claim spine (seed owner as poster, published 'posted', organizer contact stamped after publish so the stock claim email is not sent) and the answer is { status: 'built', claimUrl: /events/claim/<token>, eventUrl }; a retried item reuses its event (events.details.flowweb.item_id). Frequency sends no email here: FlowWeb's sender mails the organizer from the founder's own mailbox. Pure rules in lib/flowweb/claim.ts, IO in lib/flowweb/claim-io.ts, runbook gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md. Probe: scripts/probes/flowweb-claim.mjs.

Endpoint and claim build shipped; switch stays off until the RUNBOOKS gate passes.
